correctness.rationale: From an exact unitary parity reduction, the odd squared singular value is 4(1+q^2)(1-u); the even 2-by-2 Gram has determinant 8u(1-q)^2. Evaluation of the even characteristic polynomial at 2(1-q)^2/(1+q^2) proves that its small root lies below this value, yielding a strictly increasing inverse relation u(mu). This increasing branch crosses the decreasing odd one uniquely. The crossing gives the stated quadratic, and direct determinant/trace limits prove endpoint expansions. CHECK.py independently compared raw matrix eigenvalues in 1695 assertions.

value.rationale: The smallest symmetric Fourier heat band with a pair of repeated diffusion eigenvalues permits reconstruction with two sensors over two snapshots; optimizing the lower frame bound at fixed time separation is a natural noise-robust experiment-design question. The unique analytic angular design and its singular coincidence-time limit are structural and useful, not an arbitrary small-parameter sample. The restricted model and unproven extensions are explicit.
